FFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Burning to both the caster and the target.

FFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Defense by (1*b) for the match.

FFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Burning to the target.

FFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Burning, and an additional (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Vulnerable.

WWF.condition_required: the target is Charged or Burning
WWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency by (1*b) for the match; if the target is Charged or Burning, further decreases their Potency by (2*b) and removes the condition from them.

WWW.description: Cleanses all status effects from the caster and grants 1 rune to the rune pool.

WWE.description: Changes the weather condition to Raining (buffs Water & Plants by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Earth & Fire by (1*b) percent).

WWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and removes all buffs from the target.

WWD.description: Significantly decreases the target's stats, based on any of their active debuffs, for the match: decreases Potency by (2*b) if Weakened, Defense by (2*b) if Vulnerable, Speed by (2*b) if Slowed, and Luck by (2*b) if Blinded. If the target has none of these, decreases a random stat by (1*b).

EEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; deals (2*b) bonus damage and applies Stunned to the target if the target is Frosty.

EEW.description: Grants the caster the Shielded buff, increases Defense by (1*b) for the match, and cures Vulnerable if afflicted.

EEE.description: Deals (1*b) damage plus bonus damage equal to (1*b) percent of the target's maximum health.

EEL.description: Deals damage scaling with the caster's Health ((1*b) * Health).

EED.description: Deals 10 instances of (1*b) damage to the target.

LLF.description: Grants the caster a random buff and cures Cursed if afflicted; if Cursed was cured, additionally grants the Blessed buff.

LLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Blinded to the target.

LLE.description: Changes the weather condition to Sunny (buffs Fire, Light, and Plants each by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Dark and Ice by (1*b) percent).

LLL.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and increases all stats by (1*b) for the match.

LLD.condition_required: Weather is Sunny AND Caster is Blessed
LLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Weather is Sunny AND Caster is Blessed, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

DDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Asleep.

DDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the caster.

DDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Darkness (buffs Dark & Fey by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Light by (1*b) percent).

DDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the target.

DDD.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases all of the target's stats by (1*b) for the match.

FWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Burning to the target (chance scales with Luck).

FWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the target.

FWE.description: Changes the location to Graveyard (buffs Ghostfire & Dark by (1*b) percent).

FWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the caster.

FWD.condition_required: Target is Cursed, Weather is Blood Rain, AND Location is Graveyard
FWD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Cursed, Weather is Blood Rain, AND Location is Graveyard, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

WFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Bleeding.

WFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Luck by (1*b) for the match.

WFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Bleeding to the target (chance scales with Luck).

WFL.description: Grants the caster the Honed buff, an increase of (1*b) to Luck for the match, and cures Blinded if afflicted.

WFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if Shielded, consumes it to deal (2*b) bonus damage scaled from Defense. If Honed, consumes it to deal (2*b) bonus damage scaled from Luck.

FEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Vulnerable to the target.

FEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Entangled.

FEE.description: Gives the caster Charged and a Fire rune to their rune pool.

FEL.description: Gives the caster Honed and a Water rune to their rune pool.

FED.description: Deals (1*b) damage a number of times equal to (x + 1)**2 if x <= 2 else (4 * x if x <= 6 else x + 18), where x is the total number of debuffs on the target.

EFF.description: Decreases the target's Defense by (1*b) for the match. If the target is Vulnerable, removes it and gives the caster Honed and Quickened.

EFW.description: Gives the caster Shielded and an Earth rune to their rune pool.

EFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and increases the caster's max health by (1*b) for the match.

EFL.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and applies Poisoned to the target.

EFD.condition_required: Target is Entangled AND Location is Jungle
EFD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Entangled AND Location is Jungle, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

FLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Stunned.

FLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Stunned to the target (chance scales with Luck).

FLE.description: Changes the weather condition to Storming (buffs Lightning & Water by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Beasts & Light by (1*b) percent).

FLL.description: Grants the caster the Quickened buff and grants priority on the next turn (caster's next spell resolves first regardless of Speed).

FLD.condition_required: Target is Stunned, Caster is Charged, AND Weather is Storming
FLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Stunned, Caster is Charged, AND Weather is Storming, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

LFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Vulnerable.

LFW.description: Grants the caster the Charged buff, increases Potency by (1*b) for the match, and cures Weakened if afflicted.

LFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Stunned to the target; if the weather condition is Storming, additionally applies Stunned to the caster.

LFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather is Darkness, applies Blinded to the target.

LFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (3*b) damage if the caster is Charged and then applies Stunned to the caster.

FDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the caster is Invisible.

FDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the caster and target.

FDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Blood Rain (buffs Blood & Ghostfire by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Fey by (1*b) percent).

FDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Bleeding to the target.

FDD.condition_required: Target is Blinded AND Weather is Darkness
FDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Blinded AND Weather is Darkness, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

DFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; deals (2*b) bonus damage if the caster is Bleeding, and (2*b) bonus damage if the weather condition is Blood Rain.

DFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Bleeding and Slowed to the target.

DFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the caster, gives the caster Charged and Honed, and cures Asleep if afflicted.

DFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and heals the caster for 100 percent of the damage dealt.

DFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the target, dealing bonus damage scaling with the caster's missing health.

WEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the location is Jungle, deals (2*b) bonus damage and changes the location to none.

WEE.description: Changes the location to Jungle (buffs Beasts & Plants by (1*b) percent).

WEL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Entangled to the target.

WED.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (3*b) bonus damage if an active seedling has been rained on and sunny.

EWF.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and increases Potency by (1*b) for the match; if the weather is Sunny, heals for an additional (1*b).

EWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Poisoned to the target.

EWE.description: Plants a seedling on the battlefield that can grow over time.

EWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the target; if an active seedling is on the battlefield, consumes it to grant the caster Quickened.

EWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage. If the target is Entangled, additionally applies Bleeding to the target.

WLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Cursed.

WLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the target.

WLE.description: Changes the location to Enchanted Forest (buffs Fey by (1*b) percent).

WLD.condition_required: Target is Asleep, Weather is Darkness, AND Location is Enchanted Forest
WLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Asleep, Weather is Darkness, AND Location is Enchanted Forest, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

LWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the location is Enchanted Forest, additionally applies Vulnerable to the target.

LWW.description: Applies Asleep to both the caster and the target.

LWE.description: Grants the caster the Invisible buff for 1 round.

LWL.description: Applies Polymorphed to the target for 1 round.

LWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Polymorphed, consumes the status effect to grant the caster Invisible for 1 round.

WDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather is Raining, changes the weather to Snowing and applies Stunned to the target.

WDW.description: Grants the caster the Shielded buff; while active, if the caster takes a new instance of damage, applies Frosty to the attacker.

WDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Snowing (buffs Ice by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Fire & Plants by (1*b) percent).

WDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Frosty to the target.

WDD.condition_required: Weather is Blizzard AND Location is Tundra
WDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Weather is Blizzard AND Location is Tundra, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

DWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Frosty to the target (chance scales with Luck).

DWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Slowed to the target.

DWE.description: Changes the location to Tundra (buffs Ice by (1*b) percent).

DWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Frosty to the caster and target.

DWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Frosty, consumes the effect to deal (2*b) bonus damage and apply Vulnerable.

ELF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the caster is Bleeding, removes it and changes weather to Blood Rain.

ELW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Slowed to the target.

ELE.description: Changes the weather condition to Windy (buffs Wind by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Earth by (1*b) percent).

ELL.description: Grants the caster the Quickened buff, increases Speed by (1*b) for the match, and cures Slowed if afflicted.

ELD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the weather is Raining, and changes weather to Blizzard.

LEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Burning.

LEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and re-applies any debuff on the target, effectively resetting its duration.

LEE.description: Changes the weather condition to Sandstorm (buffs Earth & Wind by (1*b) percent, and nerfs Beasts by (1*b) percent).

LEL.description: Gives the caster Quickened and applies Slowed to the target.

LED.description: Deals damage scaling with the caster's Speed ((1*b) * Speed).

EDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Weakened.

EDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Defense by (1*b) for the match.

EDE.description: Changes the location to Swamp (buffs Poison by (1*b) percent).

EDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Poisoned to the target.

EDD.condition_required: Target is Bleeding AND Location is Swamp
EDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target is Bleeding AND Location is Swamp, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

DEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage scaling with the target's missing Potency.

DEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Luck by (1*b) for the match.

DEE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the target.

DEL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Bleeding, additionally applies Infected to the target.

DED.description: Deals (1*b) damage and removes any debuffs on target to heal the caster for each removed.

LDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Blinded to the target.

LDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Stunned to the target (chance scales with Luck).

LDE.description: Changes the location to Space (buffs Cosmic by (1*b) percent).

LDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (2*b) bonus damage if the target is Blinded.

LDD.condition_required: Target has Blinded, Weakened, Slowed, AND Vulnerable
LDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; if Target has Blinded, Weakened, Slowed, AND Vulnerable, triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage.

DLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Slowed, consumes it to increase the caster's Speed.

DLE.description: Swaps the caster and target's base Potency and Defense for the remainder of the match.

DLL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather condition is Darkness, gives the caster Charged and Quickened, and applies Slowed to the target.

DLD.description: Deals (1*b) damage scaling with the target's missing health.
